rules.title: Pattern substitution preserves pattern shape, substitutes only types
rules.statement: Monomorphizing a pattern reproduces the same pattern kind (Variant/Int/Bool/Wild/Range/VariantData/Or/Tuple/Struct/Slice/At/RefBind/RefPat) with identical structural fields (names, bindings, discriminants, has_rest, is_mut, slots); only the carried binding types are type-substituted. Sub-patterns are recursively substituted.

rules.title: Statement substitution preserves statement kind and effect flags
rules.statement: Monomorphizing a statement reproduces the same statement kind with all sub-expressions, sub-blocks, types and side-channel flags re-emitted; child expressions/blocks/patterns/types are recursively substituted while non-type metadata (names, labels, indices, slots) is preserved.

rules.title: Drop-before-replace flag survives monomorphization
rules.statement: For an assignment `x = v` and for deref-write `*p = v`, the drop-before-replace flag (drop old contents iff the place is initialized) is carried verbatim through substitution.

rules.title: Generic-param drop resolves at instantiation to the substituted type's drop
rules.statement: A drop statement whose drop-fn is the sentinel `__typevar_pending__drop` (original type was a generic param) is resolved against the substituted concrete type T: if T is Struct/ZonedStruct with a non-empty concrete name, drop-fn = `<concrete_name>__drop` and field-recursion is enabled when any field is droppable (Struct/ZonedStruct/Enum/Tuple/Array/Closure, owning TraitObject/Slice/DstRef); if T has no Drop impl the drop is skipped.

rules.title: Generic-param drop of an owning dyn payload routes to dyn drop-in-place
rules.statement: When the substituted concrete type of a `__typevar_pending__drop` is an owning trait object, the move-out drop routes to `__box_dyn__drop`; an owned unsized-dyn tail projection (UnsizedDyn, or borrow-owning TraitObject whose move source is an owned dyn tail) routes to `__dyn_drop_in_place__` (run Drop, do not free); Enum/Tuple/Array/Closure enable field-recursion instead.

rules.title: Drop call to a generic-struct template is re-mangled to the monomorphized name
rules.statement: A non-empty drop-fn whose type T is a Struct/ZonedStruct with non-empty type-args is rewritten from the template drop name to `<concrete_struct_name(T)>__drop`, pointing at the monomorphized Drop function emitted for the instance.

rules.title: Symbolic-length array iteration re-derives its length after substitution
rules.statement: A `for x in arr` over a symbolic-length array (sema recorded arr_size==0, not a slice) re-derives arr_size from the substituted iterator's concrete array type once the pack/const length is known.

rules.title: A variadic param expands to one concrete param per pack element
rules.statement: A variadic parameter `p: A...` whose type is a TypeVar bound to a type pack of length N expands into N non-variadic params named via the per-index pack-arg naming scheme, each typed by the corresponding pack element; non-variadic params are type-substituted unchanged with name/slot/owning-box-dyn flags preserved.

rules.title: Lifetime params and outlives bounds pass through mono unchanged
rules.statement: Monomorphization substitutes only type parameters; lifetime parameters and their outlives bounds are not in the substitution map and are copied verbatim onto the cloned signature (lifetime substitution is identity).

rules.title: An instantiated function carries no type parameters
rules.statement: A function produced by instantiation is monomorphic: its type-parameter list is empty; signature flags (extern, pub, macro-hook, vararg, local_count) and method-base/package are preserved, and return/param types are type-substituted.

rules.title: Clone origin: binary-module flag dropped, lazy-module flag propagated
rules.statement: An instantiated function is never marked from-binary-module (instances are new, absent from the binary archive); the from-lazy-module flag IS propagated so the clone's body is subject to the same reach-based emit filtering as lazy-archive originals.
